option_b: Gains value based on the types of all four orthogonal neighbours
option_c: Gains value based on how many distinct types surround it, in all eight directions

name: Punch
one_line_summary: Hits what is next to it
option_a: Scores points for each adjacent card it beats in rank
option_b: Scores points for each adjacent card it beats in rank, and knocks the lowest one out of the grid
option_c: Scores points for each adjacent card it beats, doubled if it beats all four

name: Spiderweb
one_line_summary: When scored, gains +1 point per card diagonally adjacent to it
option_a: On scoring, gains +1 point per diagonally adjacent card
option_b: On scoring, gains +1 point per card on both full diagonals running through its cell
option_c: On scoring, gains +1 point per diagonally adjacent card, doubled if all four diagonals are occupied

name: The Courier
one_line_summary: While spotlit, this card counts as a member of both its own column's and the adjacent column's melds
option_a: While spotlit, this card counts in both its own column's melds and the adjacent column's
option_b: While spotlit, this card counts in the melds of every line that passes within one cell of it
option_c: While spotlit, this card counts in both its own column's and its own row's melds twice over

name: The Puppet (Bunraku)
one_line_summary: Needs hands to work it
option_a: A powerful card that only functions while two or more adjacent cards support it
option_b: A powerful card that only functions while two adjacent cards support it, scaling with how many do
option_c: A powerful card that needs two supporters, and its supporters score as well when it does

name: The Giant
one_line_summary: Takes up four cells
option_a: Occupies a two-by-two footprint, and stays active only while adjacent crew cards support it
option_b: Occupies a two-by-two footprint and counts in every line it touches
option_c: Occupies a two-by-two footprint, counts in every line it touches, and collapses if any supporting neighbour leaves

name: Hunting Season
one_line_summary: Kills the middle one
option_a: If a line scores with exactly three cards, the centre card is destroyed afterwards
option_b: If a line scores with exactly three cards, the centre card is destroyed and this card takes its rank
option_c: The centre cell of any scoring line is destroyed afterwards, whatever the line's length

name: Performance Rings
one_line_summary: Depth is worth more
option_a: Score zones by board depth: rows 1 to 5 score at 1x, rows 6 to 10 at 2x, rows 11 to 15 at 3x, and so on
option_b: Score zones by board depth, with the multiplier applying only to the column score, not the row
option_c: Score zones by height rather than row: every five levels of stack height multiplies that stack's score by one more

name: Ring Column
one_line_summary: One per column: adds one grid column at game creation; its rank equals which column it is
option_a: One per column: adds a grid column at game creation, its rank equal to which column it is
option_b: One per column: adds a grid column at game creation, and can be destroyed mid-run to remove that column
option_c: One per column: adds a grid column whose cells all carry a bonus matching the column's rank

name: Sliced Bread
one_line_summary: On submission, if a same-suit card sits lower in this card's stack, gain a point per card between them
option_a: On scoring, gain a point for each card lying between this card and the nearest same-suit card lower in its stack
option_b: On scoring, gain a point for each card between this one and the nearest same-suit card anywhere in its line
option_c: On scoring, gain a point for each card between this one and every same-suit card in its line, counting each pair

name: Escaramuza
one_line_summary: When the grid's column heights read the same left-to-right as right-to-left at scoring, gain bonus multiplier on the act
option_a: If the grid's column heights read the same left to right as right to left when a line scores, the act gains a large multiplier
option_b: While the grid's column heights read the same in both directions, every line scored pays double
option_c: Any line whose ranks read the same forwards as backwards pays double

name: Sudoku-rule grid bonus
one_line_summary: Sudoku on the grid
option_a: If the ranks on a grid satisfy sudoku constraints, the grid scores a bonus
option_b: If any row, column or block satisfies sudoku constraints, that line scores a bonus
option_c: If no rank repeats in any row or column of a grid, that grid scores a bonus scaling with how full it is

name: The Hammer
one_line_summary: Half the ranks are dead
option_a: Boss: every odd-ranked card is debuffed
option_b: Boss: every card of one parity is debuffed, and which parity flips each act
option_c: Boss: every odd-ranked card is debuffed, and every even-ranked card scores double

name: The Junk Orchestra
one_line_summary: Scores by position, not by rank
option_a: Skill-less cards score by their positional pattern rather than their ranks
option_b: Skill-less cards score by positional pattern, paying more the more regular the pattern is
option_c: Skill-less cards score by positional pattern, and matching a pattern named at show start pays double

name: The Kickline
one_line_summary: A pattern across the tops of the columns
option_a: When the top cards of all five columns share a suit at scoring, the row above them scores again
option_b: When the top cards of all five columns share a suit, every line through them scores again
option_c: When the top cards of all five columns form any poker hand, that hand scores as a sixth line

name: The Pyramid
one_line_summary: A staircase of stacks
option_a: Formation: three adjacent columns holding stacks of exactly 3, 2 and 1 score a bonus meld
option_b: Formation: any three adjacent columns whose heights descend by one score a bonus meld, scaling with the height they start from
option_c: Formation: any run of columns whose heights ascend or descend by one scores a bonus meld per column involved

name: The Repulsor
one_line_summary: Only the ends of the row fire
option_a: Boss: only the first and last card of each line trigger; everything between does nothing
option_b: Boss: only the first and last card of each line trigger, and they trigger twice
option_c: Boss: only the centre card of each line triggers

name: Callback
one_line_summary: Reaches back a fixed number of turns
option_a: Cue: re-trigger whatever card you placed three turns ago, wherever it is now
option_b: Cue: re-trigger whatever card you placed on the previous turn
option_c: Cue: name a turn number; re-trigger the card you placed on that turn this show

name: The Opener
one_line_summary: Remembers what went first
option_a: Scores a bonus equal to the rank of the first card you placed this act
option_b: Scores a bonus equal to the rank of the first card placed in its own line
option_c: The first card placed each act is spotlit for the whole act, wherever it sits

name: The Running Order
one_line_summary: Reads the sequence, not the position
option_a: Scores a bonus if the cards in its line were placed in ascending rank order
option_b: Scores a bonus if the cards in its line were placed in any strictly ordered sequence, ascending or descending
option_c: Scores a bonus per card in its line that was placed in order, so a partly ordered line still pays

name: The Understudy List
one_line_summary: Placement order is recorded and readable
option_a: Rule: the order cards were placed in is tracked and shown, and effects may read it
option_b: Rule: placement order is tracked but hidden, and only specific effects may read it
option_c: Rule: placement order is tracked, and the last three placements are always visible on the board

name: The Diagonal Company
one_line_summary: Only diagonals count as adjacent
option_a: Rule: adjacency is diagonal only; orthogonal neighbours do not count as adjacent
option_b: Rule: adjacency is diagonal only for effects, but lines still score orthogonally
option_c: Rule: adjacency is diagonal only, and which it is flips each act

name: The Joined Tents
one_line_summary: Grids touch at their edges
option_a: Rule: the rightmost column of each grid is adjacent to the leftmost column of the next
option_b: Rule: grids are adjacent at their edges, and a line may cross that seam
option_c: Rule: grids are adjacent at their edges only while both are more than half full

name: The Long Reach
one_line_summary: Counts distant cells as adjacent
option_a: This card treats every cell in its own row and column as adjacent to it
option_b: This card treats every cell within two steps as adjacent to it
option_c: This card treats the mirrored cell across the grid's centre as adjacent to it

name: The Round Ring
one_line_summary: The grid wraps
option_a: Rule: the grid's left and right edges are adjacent, so rows wrap around
option_b: Rule: all four edges wrap, so the grid is a torus and every cell has four neighbours
option_c: Rule: the edges wrap, and a line that uses the wrap scores double

name: Accordion pile-combining rule
one_line_summary: Piles that combine at a distance
option_a: Stacks whose top cards match may combine if they are adjacent or exactly three apart
option_b: Stacks whose top cards match may combine if they are adjacent, three apart, or five apart
option_c: Stacks whose top cards match may combine at any distance, but only along a row

name: Any card placeable on this card
one_line_summary: Anything can go on top of it
option_a: Any card may be placed on top of this one, whatever the stacking rules say
option_b: Any card may be placed on top of this one, and doing so scores this card immediately
option_c: Any card may be placed on top of this one, and this card takes the suit of whatever lands there

name: Canfield tableau stacking rule
one_line_summary: Descending, alternating colour
option_a: Stacks build one rank lower and in the opposite colour, and a whole legal stack moves as one
option_b: Stacks build one rank lower in the opposite colour, and only single cards may be moved
option_c: Stacks build one rank lower in any suit but the same one, and a whole legal stack moves as one

name: Devil's Grip +3 rank stacking
one_line_summary: Stack by threes
option_a: Stacking requires a rank exactly three higher, with the starting row deciding the sequence
option_b: Stacking requires a rank exactly three higher or three lower
option_c: Stacking requires a fixed rank gap named at run start, the same gap for the whole run

name: Jumbo
one_line_summary: Heavy: no cards may be placed on this card, but it can be placed on anything; scores bonus points per card beneath it when scored
option_a: Nothing may be placed on this card, though it may be placed on anything; scores bonus points per card beneath it
option_b: Nothing may be placed on this card and it may only go on an empty cell; it scores triple
option_c: Nothing may be placed on this card; it scores bonus points per card in its whole column

name: Klondike empty-space king rule
one_line_summary: Only a king opens an empty cell
option_a: An empty cell can only be filled by a stack headed by the highest rank
option_b: An empty cell can only be filled by a stack headed by the highest rank, or by a single card of any rank
option_c: An empty cell can be filled by a stack headed by any face card

name: OG Placer
one_line_summary: Default placement legality: a stack may be placed where the join continues a legal run without same-suit contact
option_a: Default placement legality: a stack lands where the join continues a legal run without same-suit contact
option_b: Default placement legality: a stack lands anywhere, and an illegal join simply scores nothing
option_c: Default placement legality: a stack lands where the join is adjacent in rank, whatever the suits

name: Rosin
one_line_summary: Cards placed onto this card cannot be picked up again, but score +1 bonus per level deeper than they stand
option_a: Cards placed on this one can never be lifted again, but score +1 for each level they sit above it
option_b: Cards placed on this one can never be lifted again, and score double
option_c: Cards placed on this one can be lifted only by paying a charge, and score +1 per level above it

name: The Grip
one_line_summary: The bottom card legalises the pile
option_a: The bottom card of a stack makes everything above it legal, whatever the stacking rules say
option_b: The bottom card of a stack makes everything directly above it legal, one card only
option_c: The bottom card legalises the whole stack, and the stack cannot be broken up afterwards

name: The Mighty Atom
one_line_summary: Small, and holds up anything
option_a: A rank-3 card that can legally hold any stack above it, whatever the stacking rules
option_b: A rank-3 card that can hold any stack above it, and scores per card it is holding
option_c: A low-ranked card that can hold any stack, and the lower its rank the more it scores for doing so

name: OG Grabber
one_line_summary: Default grab legality: a stack may be picked up if it is an ascending or descending run with no two same-suit cards adjacent
option_a: Default grab legality: a stack lifts if it is an ascending or descending run with no two same-suit cards touching
option_b: Default grab legality: any stack lifts, and legality is checked only when it is put down
option_c: Default grab legality: a stack lifts if every card in it shares a suit or every card in it shares a rank

name: Ringmaster's Grip
one_line_summary: This card and the stack it heads can always be picked up, regardless of stack legality
option_a: This card and the stack it heads can always be picked up, whatever the stacking rules say
option_b: This card and the stack it heads can always be picked up, and can always be put down anywhere
option_c: Any stack containing this card can always be picked up, even from underneath it

name: The Acrobat
one_line_summary: This card can be grabbed even while covered; the cards above cascade down one slot
option_a: This card can be grabbed while covered; the cards above it cascade down one slot
option_b: This card can be grabbed while covered, taking the cards above it along as a stack
option_c: Any card can be grabbed while covered while this one is on the grid; the cards above cascade down

name: Carrier-stacking bonus points
one_line_summary: Tricks on top of other performers
option_a: A skill card stacked on another skill card scores bonus points for both
option_b: A skill card stacked on another skill card scores bonus points scaling with the stack's height
option_c: A skill card stacked on another scores bonus points, and the carrier also fires its own skill again

name: Chair stack
one_line_summary: Paid by the tallest stack
option_a: Gains a multiplier per card in the tallest column on its grid
option_b: Gains a multiplier per card in its own column
option_c: Gains a multiplier per card in the tallest column of any grid, counting across all of them

name: Mallakhamb Pole
one_line_summary: While spotlit, every card in this card's column gains bonus points per row of column height when the column scores
option_a: While spotlit, every card in this card's column gains bonus points per level of column height when that column scores
option_b: While spotlit, this card scores its rank once for every level of height beneath it
option_c: While spotlit, a height line completed in this card's column scores twice

name: Poker Crown
one_line_summary: When scored, this card and the 4 cards directly above it in its column stack are also evaluated as a poker hand, once
option_a: When this card scores, it and the four cards directly above it in its stack are also read as a poker hand, once
option_b: When this card scores, it and the four cards directly above it are read as a poker hand every time, not just once
option_c: When this card scores, the five cards nearest it in any straight line, including diagonals, are also read as a poker hand

name: The Backlift
one_line_summary: Paid by what is piled on it
option_a: Scores extra per card currently stacked on top of this one
option_b: Scores extra per card stacked on top, doubled if it is the bottom of its stack
option_c: Scores extra per card stacked on top, and the whole stack scores with it

name: Collapse
one_line_summary: Brings a whole column down
option_a: Consumable: every stack on one grid compacts to the floor at once, scoring each card that falls
option_b: Consumable: every stack on one grid compacts to the floor, scoring nothing
option_c: Consumable: one stack collapses entirely, and its cards spread into the nearest empty cells

name: Dead Weight
one_line_summary: What happens to the pile above
option_a: Rule: removing a card drops everything above it down one level
option_b: Rule: removing a card leaves a gap in the stack that only another card can fill
option_c: Rule: removing a card drops everything above it, and each card that falls scores its rank

name: The Scaffold
one_line_summary: Holds the stack up
option_a: While this card is anywhere in a stack, removing a card from that stack leaves the rest suspended
option_b: While this card is at the bottom of a stack, that stack never compacts
option_c: While this card is in a stack, cards above a removal fall two levels instead of one

name: The Tire Trick
one_line_summary: Hidden in the stack, gone when it is taken apart. (line 975)
option_a: While buried, this card is safe from everything; dismantling the stack removes it from play, and rebuilding the stack brings it back
option_b: While buried, this card is safe from everything; dismantling the stack destroys it permanently
option_c: While buried it is safe and scores nothing; dismantling the stack removes it, and it returns with a bonus when the stack is rebuilt to the same height

name: Air
one_line_summary: Whenever this card's stack changes, it automatically moves to the top of that stack
option_a: Whenever its stack changes, this card rises to the top of that stack
option_b: This card can never be covered: a card placed on it goes underneath it instead
option_c: At each Entrance refresh this card rises one position in its stack, reaching the top over time rather than at once

name: Earth
one_line_summary: Whenever this card's stack changes, it automatically sinks to the bottom of that stack, carrying its stamp with it
option_a: Whenever its stack changes, this card sinks to the bottom of that stack
option_b: This card can never be placed on another card; anything played to its cell goes on top of it
option_c: At each Entrance refresh this card sinks one position in its stack

name: Gold type
one_line_summary: Sinks, but not all the way
option_a: Sinks toward the bottom of its stack, stopping at other heavy cards, and costs more at shops
option_b: Sinks straight to the bottom of its stack regardless of what is there
option_c: Sinks one level per turn until it reaches the bottom or meets another heavy card

name: The Surveyor
one_line_summary: Everything you drop sinks
option_a: While spotlit, cards you drop resolve to the bottom of the target column instead of the top
option_b: While spotlit, cards you drop resolve to whichever end of the target column you choose
option_c: While spotlit, cards you drop resolve to the bottom of the target column, and the card displaced scores as it rises

name: Tunneler card
one_line_summary: Everything sinks past it
option_a: A single card placed on this one drops to the bottom of the stack instead
option_b: A single card placed on this one drops to the bottom of the stack, and this card scores its rank
option_c: Every card placed on this one drops to the bottom, so the stack builds downward

name: Distancing card
one_line_summary: Hovers without covering
option_a: Hovers above its stack without blocking the card beneath, and cannot be clicked
option_b: Hovers above its stack without blocking the card beneath, and counts as occupying an extra row for line purposes
option_c: Hovers above its stack without blocking anything, and any card may be placed beneath it freely

name: Ghost Light
one_line_summary: This card does not block the Spotlight of cards beneath it; they stay active as if uncovered
option_a: Does not block the spotlight of cards beneath it
option_b: Does not block the spotlight of cards beneath it, and nor does anything else in its column
option_c: Does not block the spotlight of cards beneath it, and the card directly beneath also scores when this one does

name: Kuroko
one_line_summary: This card does not block Spotlight beneath it and cannot be targeted by boss or town effects
option_a: Does not block spotlight beneath it, and cannot be targeted by boss or town effects
option_b: Does not block spotlight beneath it, and cannot be targeted by any effect at all, including your own
option_c: Does not block spotlight beneath it, and the cards beneath it cannot be targeted either

name: Glass type
one_line_summary: Transparent, and brittle
option_a: Cards behind this one stay spotlit through it, but it breaks if a Heavy card passes through
option_b: Cards behind this one stay spotlit through it, and it breaks the third time anything passes through
option_c: Cards behind this one stay spotlit, and it never breaks, but it cannot score itself

name: Global
one_line_summary: This card's modifiers are active from anywhere: grid, Entrance, deck, or discard
option_a: This card's modifiers are active from anywhere: grid, Entrance, deck or discard
option_b: This card's modifiers are active from the Entrance and the deck, but not from the discard
option_c: This card's modifiers are active from anywhere, at half effect when it is not on the grid

name: Hidden bearers (costaleros)
one_line_summary: The ones underneath are carrying it
option_a: Covered cards beneath a scoring card add their ranks to it
option_b: Covered cards beneath a scoring card add half their ranks to it, rounded down
option_c: Covered cards beneath a scoring card add their ranks to it, and each also counts as a trigger for the combo

name: Humbug
one_line_summary: While covered, counts as a copy of the most valuable card in its row; when uncovered, is revealed as junk (rank 2, base score only)
option_a: While covered, counts as a copy of the highest-value card in its row; uncovered it is junk at rank 2
option_b: While covered, counts as a copy of the highest-value card in its row; uncovering it destroys it
option_c: While covered, counts as a copy of the card covering it; uncovered it is junk at rank 2

name: Lithograph
one_line_summary: While this card sits in the Entrance its skill is active globally; on the grid it has no effect
option_a: This card's skill is active globally while it is in the Entrance, and does nothing on the grid
option_b: This card's skill is active globally from the Entrance, and at half strength on the grid
option_c: This card's skill is active from the Entrance or the deck, and does nothing on the grid

name: Revealing
one_line_summary: This card's modifiers stay active while covered
option_a: This card's modifiers stay active while it is covered
option_b: This card's modifiers stay active while covered, and it stays visible by pushing the rows below it down
option_c: This card's modifiers stay active while covered, at half strength

name: The Prompter
one_line_summary: Keeps one card in the light
option_a: While spotlit, choose one card in this card's column; that card's modifiers stay active however it is covered
option_b: While spotlit, choose one card anywhere on the grid; its modifiers stay active however it is covered
option_c: While spotlit, every card directly beneath this one keeps its modifiers active

name: The Seed
one_line_summary: Grows while it is buried
option_a: Gains +1 rank every turn it stays covered
option_b: Gains +1 rank every turn it stays covered, and loses it all the moment it is uncovered
option_c: Gains +1 rank every turn covered, keeping the gain permanently once it finally scores

name: The Spirit Cabinet
one_line_summary: Works best buried
option_a: While fully covered, every card in this card's column triggers as though spotlit
option_b: While fully covered, every card in this card's grid triggers as though spotlit
option_c: While fully covered, this card's own column triggers as though spotlit, and the effect grows with how deeply it is buried

name: The Stilt-Walker
one_line_summary: Tall enough to be seen over one card
option_a: Spotlit even when covered by one card, but not by two
option_b: Spotlit even when covered by one card, and the card covering it is spotlit too
option_c: Spotlit through any number of covering cards, but its effects work at half strength per card above it

name: Champion card
one_line_summary: Clears its own rank above and below
option_a: Cards of the same rank directly above or below this one are discarded
option_b: Cards of the same rank anywhere in this card's column are discarded, and this card gains a rank for each
option_c: Cards of the same rank adjacent in any direction are discarded, and this card scores their summed rank

name: Edith's Bayonet
one_line_summary: Cue: permanently destroy one Knives-suit card and add its rank to this card's own, forever
option_a: Cue: destroy one card of this card's own suit anywhere on the grid and add its rank to this card's, permanently
option_b: Cue: destroy the card directly above this one and add its rank to this card's, permanently
option_c: Automatically destroys any card of its own suit placed orthogonally adjacent to it, gaining half that card's rank

name: Gentling
one_line_summary: Tame it instead of eating it
option_a: Animal cards may be buffed into loyalty rather than consumed, gaining rank without being destroyed
option_b: Animal cards may be buffed into loyalty rather than consumed; a loyal card cannot be eaten by anything afterwards
option_c: Any card may be tamed rather than eaten, gaining half the rank the eater would have taken

name: Hungry Hippo
one_line_summary: Consumes cards dropped onto it, adding their rank to its own up to a cap of 13, and returns everything eaten at show end
option_a: Eats cards placed on it, adding their rank to its own up to 13, and gives everything back at show end
option_b: Eats cards placed on it, adding their rank to its own up to 13; what it eats is destroyed
option_c: Eats cards placed on it, adding half their rank rounded up with no cap, and gives them back at show end

name: Mabel's Tigers
one_line_summary: Consumes prop (skill-less) cards dropped on it, gaining +1 rank per card eaten, with no cap, permanently
option_a: Eats skill-less cards placed on it, gaining +1 rank each, permanently and without cap
option_b: Eats skill-less cards placed on it, gaining that card's full rank, permanently and without cap
option_c: Eats any card placed on it for +1 rank, but loses 1 rank at the end of each show

name: Sin of Gluttony
one_line_summary: Consumes cards from anywhere (grid, Entrance, or decks, via cue), with no cap, permanently gaining rank
option_a: Cue: consume any card anywhere - grid, Entrance or deck - gaining its rank permanently, with no cap
option_b: Cue: consume any card anywhere, gaining its rank permanently with no cap, but the consumed card is removed from the run
option_c: Consumes automatically: at each Entrance refresh it eats the lowest-ranked card on its grid and gains that rank permanently

name: Parasite card
one_line_summary: Replaces its host
option_a: Attaches to the next card placed on it; on submit, it replaces that card
option_b: Attaches to the next card placed on it; on submit it replaces that card and keeps its rank
option_c: Attaches to the next card placed on it and slowly drains its rank each turn, replacing it at rank 0

name: Snake card
one_line_summary: Eats downward through the stack
option_a: Consumes every lower-ranked card beneath it, leaving a temporary body card of the same rank behind each
option_b: Consumes every lower-ranked card beneath it outright, leaving nothing behind
option_c: Consumes one lower-ranked card beneath it per turn, leaving a body card each time

name: The Digesting Duck
one_line_summary: Consumes cards dropped on it like a Glutton, but secretly stores them; cue to return any one stored card to the Entrance
option_a: Consumes cards dropped on it but stores them instead of destroying them; cue to return any one stored card to the Entrance
option_b: Consumes cards dropped on it and stores them; all stored cards return to the deck at show end
option_c: Consumes cards dropped on it and stores them; cue to return one, and it scores bonus points per card still stored

name: Vampire
one_line_summary: Eats the enhancements off cards
option_a: Gains a permanent multiplier per stamped card that scores, and strips that card's stamp
option_b: Gains a permanent multiplier per stamped card that scores, leaving the stamp intact
option_c: Gains a permanent multiplier per stamped card that scores and strips the stamp, keeping it for itself

name: Conjoined cards
one_line_summary: Two cards, one body
option_a: Two cards are permanently fused side by side; they move as one unit but score as two
option_b: Two cards are permanently fused; they move as one unit and score as one card of summed rank
option_c: Two cards are fused until one of them scores, at which point they separate

name: Frankenstein
one_line_summary: On submit, merges with the cards directly above and below it into one 3-card stack of summed rank that stays in the zone after scoring
option_a: On Submit, merges with the cards directly above and below into one card of their summed rank
option_b: Cue: merges with the card directly above into one card carrying both suits and their summed rank
option_c: On Submit, merges with its whole stack into one card of summed rank, capped at 30

name: The Castell
one_line_summary: Formation: a stack of 6+ cards topped by the lowest-ranked card pays a large bonus at scoring; if the stack is broken by a hazard first, lose double the bonus instead
option_a: A stack of six or more topped by its own lowest-ranked card pays a large bonus at scoring; if a hazard breaks it first, lose double that bonus
option_b: A stack of six or more topped by its own lowest-ranked card pays a large bonus, with no penalty for breaking
option_c: Any stack topped by its own lowest-ranked card pays a bonus scaling with the stack's height

name: The Contortionist
one_line_summary: May share one grid slot with another card; both cards count in melds
option_a: May share one cell with another card; both count in melds
option_b: May share one cell with another card; both count in melds, and the pair scores as a single card of their summed rank
option_c: May share a cell with any number of cards, but only the top two count in melds

name: The Foot Juggler
one_line_summary: Holds one card spinning above itself
option_a: Holds one card suspended in a sub-slot above itself, playable from there at any time
option_b: Holds one card suspended above itself; that card scores in every line this card belongs to
option_c: Holds up to two cards suspended above itself, played one at a time

name: The Half Card

name: The Stray Whistle

option_b: Each Entrance refresh deals one extra card, plus one more for every Clown-class card on the grid

name: Discard-to-deck on score
one_line_summary: Puts two back in the deck

option_b: On score, two cards of your choice return from the discard to the deck

name: The Egg Bag

name: Lucky Streak
one_line_summary: Grants +1 reroll per shop visit; after it activates, repeated actions for the rest of the show never repeat identical results

name: Deck auto-slotter
one_line_summary: Slots itself in from the deck
option_a: While in the deck, this card moves itself into any legal empty cell that becomes available
option_b: While in the deck, this card moves itself into a legal empty cell once per show

one_line_summary: Every Entrance refresh, automatically plays the top card of the deck into this card's column

option_b: Every Entrance refresh, the top card of the deck is played automatically into a random empty cell of this card's grid
option_c: Every Entrance refresh, the top card of the deck is played automatically into this card's column, and this card scores for each one that completes a line

name: Scan deck/discard for scoring
one_line_summary: Scoring reaches into the decks

name: Blue Joker

option_b: Scores bonus points per card remaining in the deck, halving once the deck is under a quarter full

name: The Census

option_b: Scores a large bonus while your deck contains no cards of a named class

option_b: Scores a bonus per distinct class present in your deck, doubled if every class is

name: Certificate
one_line_summary: Deals in a card with a stamp on it
option_a: At the start of each show, adds a random card carrying a random stamp to the Entrance
option_b: At the start of each show, adds a random card carrying a stamp you choose

name: Hall of Mirrors

one_line_summary: Adds a card if it never performs

option_b: When this card sits alone in its row, discard it and draw two cards into the Entrance
option_c: When this card sits alone with nothing adjacent, discard it and draw two; if it is never alone, it scores nothing

name: The Signed Card

option_b: Creates a temporary card that lasts a few shows; if it scores in every one of them, it stays

name: Spirit Photo
one_line_summary: Consumable: creates an intangible ghost copy of an owned card that plays for one show at half score, then disappears

option_b: Consumable: an intangible ghost copy of one owned card plays for three shows at half score, then vanishes
option_c: Consumable: an intangible ghost copy of one owned card plays at full score for one show, and cannot be targeted

name: The Guest Star
one_line_summary: Consumable: a random Legendary card joins the deck for exactly 3 shows then departs, kept permanently if a hidden condition is met during its stay
option_a: Consumable: a random Legendary joins the deck for exactly three shows, kept permanently if a hidden condition is met while it is there
option_b: Consumable: a random Legendary joins the deck for exactly three shows, then leaves
option_c: Consumable: a random Legendary joins the deck permanently, but one card of the same rarity leaves

name: Cat Tag
one_line_summary: Two of the same merge upward
option_a: Two of these at the same level merge into one of the next level when combined
option_b: Two of these merge into the next level, and the top level converts into a permanent card
option_c: Any two identical consumables merge into a stronger single one

name: DNA
one_line_summary: Copies your opening card
option_a: If the first placement of a show is a single card, a permanent copy of it joins the deck and arrives in the Entrance
option_b: If the first placement of a show is a single card, a copy of it joins the deck for that show only
option_c: The first card placed each show is copied permanently, whatever else you place after it

name: Genie's Wish
one_line_summary: Consumable: choose any card in your deck and create a full copy of it in the Entrance for this show, which becomes permanent in the deck afterward
option_a: Consumable: choose any card in your deck; a copy appears in the Entrance and joins the deck permanently after the show

option_c: Consumable: choose any card in your deck and duplicate it permanently, but the original is out for the rest of the show

one_line_summary: Held long enough, it copies something
option_a: After being held through two shows, sell it to duplicate another card you own at random
option_b: After being held through two shows, sell it to duplicate another card you choose
option_c: After being held through two shows it duplicates a random card of yours automatically, then leaves

one_line_summary: Copies a consumable, for free

option_b: At the end of each shop, creates a copy of one consumable you choose
option_c: Every consumable you use leaves a slot-free copy of itself behind, once per show

name: SUS
one_line_summary: Copies one card and destroys the rest
option_a: At each show's end, copies one card from the Entrance and destroys all the others
option_b: At each show's end, copies one card of your choice from the Entrance and destroys the rest
option_c: At each show's end, copies the Entrance card that scored most and destroys the rest

option_a: Copies another deck card's name, class and identity for every check until it has scored three times, then is unmasked
option_b: Copies another deck card's identity permanently, and can never be unmasked
option_c: Copies another deck card's identity until it is covered; being covered unmasks it

name: The Costume Fitting
one_line_summary: On show start, copies the stamp of one adjacent card for the duration of the show
option_a: At show start, copies the stamp of one adjacent card for the whole show
option_b: At show start, copies the stamp of any card on the grid for the whole show
option_c: Copies the stamp of whichever card is adjacent to it, updating whenever its neighbours change

option_a: Choose a deck card when this is acquired: this card scores 150% of that card's base points, but only while the original is off the board
option_b: Choose a deck card when this is acquired: this card scores 150% of its base points whenever the original is also on the board

option_b: Face cards become Gold cards when they score, and stay gold permanently

option_b: Cards placed on top of this one take its suit permanently, even after they leave
option_c: Cards placed on top of this one take its suit, and so do their orthogonal neighbours

option_a: Cue: swap the ranks of this card and one adjacent card
option_b: Cue: swap the ranks of any two cards in this card's line
option_c: Cue: give this card's rank to an adjacent card and take that card's rank, keeping whichever is higher for itself

option_b: Once per turn, swap the ranks of any two cards in the same line for free
option_c: Once per turn, rotate the ranks of any three adjacent cards one step for free

option_c: Lowers the rank of the last card you interacted with by one every refresh, until it is discarded

option_a: At show start, writes a copy of an effect that fired last show onto one blank card; it fades at show end
option_b: At show start, writes a copy of an effect that fired last show onto one blank card; it stays until that card is destroyed
option_c: At show start, writes a copy of any effect in your deck onto one blank card; it fades at show end

option_b: Cue, once per show: permanently give one skill-less card a copy of any skill already on the grid
option_c: Cue: give one skill-less card a bonus-scoring ability for this show only, with unlimited uses

option_a: Holds one stamp in reserve; cue to apply it permanently to any spotlit card, and it refills at the next shop
option_b: Holds one stamp in reserve; cue to apply it permanently to any card at all, and it refills at the next shop
option_c: Holds up to three stamps in reserve; cue to apply one per show

option_b: Cue: reroll any card in the deck into another card of the same rarity
option_c: Cue: reroll any card in the deck into another of the same class, once per show, keeping whichever you prefer

option_b: At each shop's end, randomises the values of everything in it, permanently

option_b: Becomes a random skill on every Entrance refresh, drawn only from skills already in your deck

option_b: Cue, 3 charges per show: re-roll the ranks of every card in one line
option_c: Cue, 3 charges per show: re-roll the rank of one card of your choice, anywhere

option_b: Consumable: re-roll the ranks of every card in one row, and keep whichever result scores higher
option_c: Consumable: re-roll the ranks of every card in one line, chosen after you see the result of the first roll

option_a: Boss: one random card you own is replaced by another every act
option_b: Boss: one random card you own is replaced every act, and you see what it becomes before the act resolves
option_c: Boss: one random card is replaced every act, and any card that scored that act is safe

name: Pizza

option_b: After several shows, this card becomes six smaller cards, and you keep it too
option_c: You choose when it breaks; the longer you wait, the more pieces it makes

option_b: Cue: split a card into two cards of half rank that must be placed in different grids; this card is spent for the show
option_c: Cue: split a card into two of half rank; if both later score in the same line, they merge back at double rank

name: The Half Card talent
one_line_summary: Splits down the diagonal
option_a: On placement, splits into two halves along the diagonal: one keeps the rank and stamp, the other only the suit; stacking the halves back together scores them as their own meld
option_b: On placement, splits into two cards each holding half the original rank
option_c: On placement it splits, and the halves may be placed in different grids; reuniting them anywhere scores a large bonus

name: The Lion Dance

option_a: When destroyed it splits into two cards of half rank instead of dying; placed onto a card, it takes bonus points from the one beneath
option_b: When destroyed it splits into two cards of half rank; the halves cannot split again
option_c: When destroyed it splits into two cards of half rank, and each half can split again down to rank 1

option_a: This card occupies no slot, so it is carried in addition to your normal capacity

option_c: This card occupies no slot, but it cannot be sold or moved once acquired

name: Nostalgic Deck
one_line_summary: One pool of slots for everything
option_a: Skill slots and consumable slots are one shared pool
option_b: Skill slots and consumable slots are one shared pool, and the pool is smaller than the two were

name: Shared charge system
one_line_summary: One charge system for everything

option_b: All charge-based effects share one system, and unused charges carry over instead of spending themselves
option_c: All charge-based effects draw from a single shared pool rather than each holding their own

name: The Metronome
one_line_summary: More charges, everywhere
option_a: Every charge-based effect on your cards gains +1 maximum charge
option_b: Every charge-based effect gains +1 maximum charge, and one spent charge is refunded per show
option_c: Charges become a shared pool across all your cards rather than per-card, with +1 to the pool

name: Clockwork Joker
one_line_summary: Four clocks, and they can align
option_a: Runs four staggered timers with different periods, each firing its own effect; when all four coincide it copies itself
option_b: Runs four staggered timers, each firing its own effect, with no bonus for alignment
option_c: Runs four staggered timers whose periods you set once, and aligning all four copies the card

name: Happy House
one_line_summary: A very long fuse
option_a: Does nothing until a large number of acts have been played, then raises the multiplier to a power
option_b: Does nothing until a large number of acts have passed, then pays a single enormous lump sum
option_c: Its threshold is hidden and revealed only as you approach it, then it raises the multiplier to a power

name: Loyalty Card
one_line_summary: Fires hard, but rarely
option_a: Every sixth act, this card scores a large multiplier; the rest do nothing
option_b: Every sixth act it scores a large multiplier, and the counter carries across shows
option_c: Every Nth act it scores a large multiplier, and you set N when you acquire it

name: Maximum Effort
one_line_summary: Doubles this card's points on score; afterward it is Exhausted (scores nothing) until a show passes in which it was never played
option_a: Doubles this card's points, then Exhausts it until a show passes in which it was never played
option_b: Doubles this card's points, then Exhausts it for exactly one show
option_c: Triples this card's points, then Exhausts it until you pay gold to refresh it

name: Campfire
one_line_summary: Grows on what you sell, resets on bosses
option_a: Gains a permanent multiplier for each card sold, reset whenever a boss is beaten
option_b: Gains a permanent multiplier for each card sold, never reset
option_c: Gains a multiplier for each card sold, and beating a boss banks the current value rather than resetting it

name: Cheat Day
one_line_summary: If the show is won with cards still in the deck, every remaining deck card gains +1 rank permanently
option_a: If a show is won with cards still in the deck, every card left in the deck gains +1 rank permanently
option_b: If a show is won with cards still in the deck, this card gains +1 rank per card left, permanently
option_c: At the end of every show, the five cards nearest the bottom of the deck gain +1 rank permanently

name: Constellation
one_line_summary: Grows every time you spend a consumable
option_a: Gains a permanent multiplier every time a consumable is used
option_b: Gains a permanent multiplier every time a consumable is used, doubled for rarer ones
option_c: Gains a permanent multiplier per consumable used, and a further one per distinct consumable used

name: Double Scale
one_line_summary: Growth that curves upward
option_a: Every card that grows with use grows quadratically rather than linearly
option_b: Every card that grows with use grows quadratically, but resets at the end of each show
option_c: Every card that grows with use grows quadratically, and the curve steepens once past a threshold

name: Energia
one_line_summary: Copies rewards, more each time
option_a: Whenever you take a reward, it is copied; the number of copies rises by one each time
option_b: Whenever you take a reward it is copied once, always
option_c: Whenever you take a reward it is copied, the count rising each time, and resetting when you skip one

name: First of May
one_line_summary: A random Common card that permanently upgrades to its Rare version after scoring 10 times across the run
option_a: After scoring 10 times in a run, this card permanently becomes its Rare version
option_b: After scoring 10 times in a run, this card permanently gains one rarity tier, and can keep doing so
option_c: Gains +1 rank each time it scores, and at rank 20 permanently becomes its Rare version

name: Glass Joker
one_line_summary: Feeds on a particular kind of death
option_a: Gains a permanent multiplier every time a card of a named type is destroyed
option_b: Gains a permanent multiplier every time any card is destroyed, at half the rate
option_c: Gains a permanent multiplier per card of a named type destroyed, and it names the type when acquired

name: Hiker
one_line_summary: Every card it sees gets permanently better
option_a: Every card that scores permanently gains a small flat bonus
option_b: Every card that scores permanently gains a small flat bonus, capped per card
option_c: Every card that scores permanently gains a bonus, and this card gains one too for each

name: Hologram
one_line_summary: Grows with the deck
option_a: Gains a permanent multiplier every time a card is added to your deck
option_b: Gains a permanent multiplier per card added, and loses one per card removed
option_c: Gains a permanent multiplier per card added, doubled if the card was created rather than bought

name: Jimball
one_line_summary: Rewards playing the same hand over and over
option_a: Gains a multiplier per consecutive act in which you score your most-played hand type
option_b: Gains a multiplier per act in which you score your most-played hand, consecutive or not
option_c: Gains a multiplier per consecutive act scoring the same hand, and loses it all when you switch

name: Light Card
one_line_summary: Grows, and asks for more
option_a: Gains a multiplier each time it scores in a full line, and raises the line size it requires by one
option_b: Gains a multiplier each time it scores, and raises its own rank requirement each time
option_c: Gains a multiplier each time it scores in a full line, and its requirement resets each show

name: Pot of Jokes
one_line_summary: Starts as a penalty and grows out of it
option_a: Begins by shrinking the Entrance, and gives one slot back every show until it is a net gain
option_b: Begins by shrinking the Entrance, recovering one slot per show until it is neutral, and no further
option_c: Begins by shrinking the Entrance, and recovers one slot every time a line scores

name: Ride the Bus
one_line_summary: A streak that a face card breaks
option_a: Gains a multiplier per consecutive act with no face card scoring, resetting the moment one does
option_b: Gains a multiplier per consecutive act with no face card, and keeps half through the reset
option_c: Gains a multiplier per consecutive act without any card of a rank you name

name: Runner
one_line_summary: Permanent growth from one hand type
option_a: Gains a permanent flat bonus each time a line scores as a named hand type
option_b: Gains a permanent flat bonus each time a line scores as any hand type it has not scored before
option_c: Gains a permanent bonus per named hand type scored, and the named type changes each show

name: Self-Granted Title
one_line_summary: This card counts as one rarity higher for all effects and bonuses, but not for pack or shop pool rolls
option_a: Counts as one rarity higher for every effect and bonus, but not for pack or shop pool rolls
option_b: Counts as one rarity higher for everything, pack and shop rolls included
option_c: Counts as one rarity higher for every effect, and gains a further tier each time it wins a show single-handedly

name: The Fadista
one_line_summary: Scores bonus points per card destroyed or lost this run
option_a: Scores bonus points for every card destroyed or lost this run
option_b: Scores bonus points for every card destroyed or lost this show
option_c: Gains +1 permanent rank for every third card destroyed or lost this run

name: The Gentled Beast
one_line_summary: Cards dropped on this card are not consumed but returned to the column below it; each one permanently adds +1 to this card's score bonus
option_a: Cards dropped on this one are not consumed but pass down to the column below it, and each permanently adds +1 to this card's bonus
option_b: Cards dropped on this one pass down to the column below and each adds +1 to this card's bonus for the show only
option_c: Cards dropped on this one pass down to the column below, and each adds +1 rank to this card permanently

name: The Murga
one_line_summary: Paid by the run's history
option_a: Scores per boss beaten, per card lost and per event survived this run
option_b: Scores per boss beaten this run only
option_c: Scores per boss beaten, card lost and event survived, and remembers across runs on the same profile

name: Weary Willie
one_line_summary: Feeds on your losses
option_a: Gains +1 rank permanently every time one of your cards is destroyed or a show is failed
option_b: Gains +1 rank permanently per card destroyed, and +5 per show failed
option_c: Gains +1 rank per card destroyed, and loses it all the moment a show is won without any losses

name: Clicked Cookie
one_line_summary: Wears out as you use it
option_a: A large flat bonus that shrinks by one every time this card is cued
option_b: A large flat bonus that shrinks every time it is cued, and is destroyed at zero
option_c: A large flat bonus that shrinks with use and recovers one step per show it goes uncued

name: Fast Food M
one_line_summary: On a timer you can extend
option_a: A large bonus that self-destructs after a few shows; a specific action adds a show to its life
option_b: A large bonus that self-destructs after a few shows, with no way to extend it
option_c: A large bonus on a timer you may extend by paying gold, at a rising price each time

name: Glass
one_line_summary: Scores double points, and is destroyed permanently after its third score
option_a: Scores double, and is destroyed for good after its third score
option_b: Scores double, with a 1-in-4 chance of shattering each time it scores
option_c: Scores double, and is destroyed at the end of any show in which it was covered

name: Ice Cream
one_line_summary: Melts as the show runs
option_a: Starts with a large flat bonus that shrinks with every act played, ending at nothing
option_b: Starts with a large flat bonus that shrinks each act, and is destroyed when it reaches nothing
option_c: Starts with a large bonus that shrinks each act, and cue at any time to cash out what remains

name: Persistent spin-buff (Sangmo)
one_line_summary: Keeps spinning while the combo holds
option_a: A buff that lasts as long as the combo keeps rising, and ends the moment it does not
option_b: A buff that decays one step per act unless re-triggered
option_c: A buff that lasts while the combo rises and, when it ends, pays out everything it accumulated

name: Starfruit
one_line_summary: A huge exponent that rerolls away
option_a: Raises the multiplier to a power, losing part of the exponent with every shop reroll
option_b: Raises the multiplier to a power, losing part of the exponent every act
option_c: Raises the multiplier to a power that decays with rerolls, and recovers if you leave a shop without rerolling

name: The Top
one_line_summary: Spins until it topples
option_a: Cue to set it spinning: it scores a little every turn until it topples after a random duration
option_b: Cue to set it spinning: it scores a little every turn and topples after exactly five turns
option_c: Cue to set it spinning; it scores more each turn it stays up, and topples on a rising chance

name: Wax
one_line_summary: Melts near fire
option_a: At each show end, loses 1 rank per Flames card that shared its column that show, and is destroyed at rank 0
option_b: At each show end, loses 1 rank per Flames card anywhere on its grid, and is destroyed at rank 0
option_c: Loses 1 rank the moment any Flames card is placed in its column, and is destroyed at rank 0

name: Burn After Reading
one_line_summary: Spent the moment it is read
option_a: Cue: apply this card's effect to any target, then destroy this card
option_b: Cue: apply this card's effect to any target; the card survives but can never be cued again
option_c: Cue: apply this card's effect, then destroy it; it returns to the deck at the end of the run

name: The Farewell Tour
one_line_summary: Fires once, enormously
option_a: This card's effect fires once at several times its normal strength, then the card is spent for the run
option_b: This card's effect fires once at several times strength, then the card is spent for the show only
option_c: This card's effect fires once per show at double strength, and is spent for the run after the third

name: The Last Rites
one_line_summary: Pays out on its way out
option_a: When this card is destroyed by anything, it fires its effect one final time
option_b: When this card is destroyed, it fires its effect one final time at double strength
option_c: When any card of yours is destroyed, it fires its effect one final time

name: Flagpole Sitter
one_line_summary: Gains bonus points for each consecutive show it ends as the top card of the same column; any move resets the streak to zero
option_a: Gains bonus points for each consecutive show it ends as the top card of the same column; any move resets it
option_b: Gains +1 rank for each consecutive show it is never moved; being moved returns it to its printed rank
option_c: Gains a stacking multiplier for each consecutive show it ends in the exact same cell; being moved or covered resets it

name: The Holdout
one_line_summary: Stores one card outside the game across shows; cue once per run to insert it into any stack at any moment, but a town search loses it
option_a: Stores one card outside the game across shows; cue once per run to insert it into any stack at any moment, and a town search loses it
option_b: Stores one card outside the game across shows; cue once per show to insert it into any stack
option_c: Stores one card outside the game; it returns automatically at the moment its line would complete

name: Season Ticket
one_line_summary: The run leaves something behind
option_a: Rule: the highest-scoring card of each run is added to the next run's starting deck
option_b: Rule: the highest-scoring card of each run is added to the pool, not the deck
option_c: Rule: one card of your choice from each finished run joins the next run's deck, upgraded

name: The Scrapbook
one_line_summary: Remembers across runs
option_a: This card's accumulated total never resets, growing across every run it appears in
option_b: This card's accumulated total never resets, but it starts each run at a quarter of what it held
option_c: This card's total carries across runs, and resets the first time a run is lost

name: The Trunk
one_line_summary: Packs something for next time
option_a: One card of your choice keeps everything it gained into the next run
option_b: One card of your choice keeps half of what it gained into the next run
option_c: One card keeps what it gained, and the card chosen is locked into the next run's starting deck

name: Permanent-toggle effect archetype
one_line_summary: Once on, never off
option_a: Once activated, this effect stays active for the rest of the show and can never be switched off
option_b: Once activated, this effect stays active for the rest of the run and can never be switched off
option_c: Once activated it stays active permanently, and its strength grows the longer it has been on

name: The Trance
one_line_summary: Goes into a trance

option_b: Enters a trance for several turns, immune and autonomous, and cannot be brought out early
option_c: Enters a trance you can end at any time; the longer it lasts the greater the payout and the harder the Exhaust

option_b: Cards carry statuses, and a card may hold only one at a time, the newest replacing the oldest

name: The Alchemist

option_a: Cue: turn every status of one kind on a target card into another kind, keeping the count
option_b: Cue: turn every status of one kind anywhere on the grid into another kind, keeping the count
option_c: Cue: turn every negative status on a target card into the positive status of your choice

name: The Fire Breather

option_a: Cue: apply Burning to every card in this card's row, then Exhaust this card
option_b: Cue: apply Burning to every card in this card's row and column, then Exhaust this card
option_c: Cue: apply Burning to any five cells you choose in its grid, then Exhaust this card

option_b: Cards catch Burning in an expanding snake, which can be stopped by completing a line in its path
option_c: Cards catch Burning in an expanding snake whose direction is telegraphed one turn ahead

option_b: Burning spreads to any card and is blocked only by a card that has already burned
option_c: Burning spreads along a suit and is blocked by any card of the opposing suit

option_b: At each Entrance refresh, every status on this card copies to all its orthogonal neighbours
option_c: At each Entrance refresh, statuses spread one cell outward from every card that carries one, anywhere on the grid

option_b: Whenever a card is placed on this one, the covering card catches Burning, and so does everything above it

option_b: Ignores the first hazard or debuff that would affect it each show, whatever its source

option_b: This card can never carry a status at all, good or bad
option_c: Statuses applied to this card are passed to the card directly above it instead

name: Digital

option_b: This card cannot be removed from the grid or the deck by any effect, including your own
option_c: This card cannot be removed from the grid; an effect that tries removes the card above it instead

option_a: Immune to the first destruction or debuff that targets it each show
option_b: Immune to all destruction, but not to debuffs
option_c: Immune to the first destruction each show, which is redirected to the card above it

name: Lloyd's Policy

option_a: The first destruction or debuff on this card is prevented and mints 2 Gold tokens
option_b: Destruction and debuffs on this card are prevented once per show, minting 1 Gold token

option_a: Cue, once per show: every card on the grid sheds one debuff or status
option_b: Cue, once per show: every card on the grid sheds all debuffs and statuses
option_c: Cue with unlimited uses: one card sheds all its debuffs and statuses

name: Palette Cleanser Tag

option_b: Consumable: removes one sticker of your choice from a card of your choice
option_c: Consumable: removes every sticker from one card, good and bad alike

name: Sacred juggling (Daikagura)

option_a: Each Balls meld scored removes one debuff
option_b: Each Balls meld scored removes one debuff from every card in that meld
option_c: Each meld of the suit this card carries removes one debuff from the grid

name: The Incubator

option_b: Each turn a card sits covered by this one, that card sheds all debuffs; lost rank is not restored
option_c: Every card in this card's column sheds one debuff per turn, whether covered or not

name: The Sunshine Clown

option_b: While spotlit, removes one debuff per turn from every card in its grid, and never applies debuffs itself
option_c: While spotlit, removes one debuff per turn from the cards below it and converts each removed debuff into points

name: Candy Cane
one_line_summary: Retriggers pay in gold
option_a: For the next several shows, every retriggered card pays gold
option_b: For the rest of the run, every retriggered card pays gold at a lower rate
option_c: Every retriggered card pays gold, and the rate rises with the number of retriggers in that act

name: Cloud 9
one_line_summary: Paid for a rank you own
option_a: Earn gold at show end for each card of a named rank in your deck
option_b: Earn gold at show end for each card of a named rank in your deck, with the rank changing each show
option_c: Earn gold at show end for each card of the rank you own most of

name: Fridge Magnet
one_line_summary: Pays more the less you own
option_a: Earns gold at each show's end, multiplied several times over if you own few cards
option_b: Earns gold at each show's end, scaling inversely with how many cards you own
option_c: Earns gold scaling inversely with deck size, so thinning the deck pays twice

name: Gold

option_a: Cards of this suit trade at full value in shops, and one scoring mints a Heavy Gold token to the deck bottom
option_b: Cards of this suit trade at full value, and score points equal to the gold you currently hold
option_c: Cards of this suit trade at full value, and any line containing one pays its score in gold instead of points

name: Misdirection theft
one_line_summary: A hand in the town's pocket
option_a: When the largest meld of a submit scores, a card may steal from the town for bonus gold
option_b: When the largest meld of a submit scores, a card steals gold from the town, at the cost of town reputation
option_c: Every meld that scores above a threshold steals a little gold, and being caught once ends it for the run

name: Gold Stake

option_b: Some cards arrive rented, costing gold every show, and may be bought out for a lump sum
option_c: Some cards arrive rented, and the rent falls each show until they become yours

name: Mud Show

option_a: Town rule: every stack pickup this show discards the top card of the deck
option_b: Town rule: every stack pickup after the first each turn discards the top card of the deck
option_c: Town rule: picking a stack up is free, but putting it down anywhere other than where it came from discards the deck's top card

name: Sapphire Stake

option_a: Difficulty: lose a quarter of your gold at the end of each tier, up to a cap
option_b: Difficulty: lose a quarter of your gold at each tier's end, with no cap
option_c: Difficulty: lose a quarter of your gold at each tier's end, unless you spent none that tier

name: The Sponsorship
one_line_summary: Money now, a cut forever
option_a: Two gold tokens at every show start, in exchange for occupying a stamp slot on your two highest cards and cutting payouts by 10%
option_b: Two gold tokens at every show start, in exchange for cutting payouts by 10%
option_c: Gold tokens at every show start equal to the number of shows played, in exchange for cutting payouts by 10% each time it pays

name: The Tooth
one_line_summary: Every card you play costs you
option_a: Lose gold for every card placed
option_b: Lose gold for every card placed after the first each act
option_c: Lose gold for every card placed, and gain double that for every line completed

name: Compound Interest
one_line_summary: Interest that compounds
option_a: Earns a percentage of your gold at each show's end, and the percentage rises with each consecutive payout
option_b: Earns a fixed percentage of your gold at each show's end
option_c: Earns a percentage that compounds, and resets the moment you spend below a threshold

name: Economy Tag
one_line_summary: Doubles what you have
option_a: Consumable: doubles your gold, up to a cap
option_b: Consumable: doubles your gold with no cap
option_c: Consumable: doubles your gold up to a cap, and the cap rises each town

name: Rocket
one_line_summary: A payout that grows with every boss
option_a: Earn gold at the end of each show, and the amount rises permanently each time a boss is beaten
option_b: Earn gold at the end of each show, rising permanently each time a show is won at all
option_c: Earn gold each show, rising per boss beaten, and resetting if a show is lost

name: Cards cannot retire until scored
one_line_summary: Nothing leaves until it has performed
option_a: A card cannot be sold or removed until it has scored, or its ability has fired, at least once
option_b: A card cannot be sold or removed until it has scored at least once; abilities firing do not count
option_c: A card cannot be sold until it has scored, and its sale value rises with how often it has

name: Diet Cola

option_a: Sell this card to create a free bonus of a named kind
option_b: Sell this card to create a free bonus you choose from three
option_c: Sell this card to create a free bonus scaling with how long you held it

name: Egg

option_a: Gains sell value at the end of every show
option_b: Gains sell value at the end of every show, and loses it all if it ever scores
option_c: Gains sell value every show, accelerating the longer it goes unsold

name: Emergency Chips

option_a: Selling this card immediately scores a fixed fraction of the show's goal
option_b: Selling this card scores a fraction of the goal, larger the earlier in the show you sell it
option_c: Selling this card scores a fraction of the remaining goal, so it is worth most when you are behind

name: Gift Card

option_a: At the end of each show, every other card you own gains sell value
option_b: At the end of each show, every other card of the same class gains sell value
option_c: At the end of each show, every other card gains sell value, and this card gains the total gained

name: The Chamber (Waxworks)

option_b: Map node: sells likenesses of your destroyed cards for gold, at a price scaling with what they scored while alive
option_c: Map node: sells likenesses of your destroyed cards, or buys one back as a playable copy
